profile.headline: Software Engineer | Staff+ Scope in AI & Distributed Systems | Long-Term SMB Investor
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer (L6) with 17+ years of experience architecting scalable distributed systems and AI-driven platforms. At Amazon, I work on Rufus, the GenAI-powered Shopping Assistant, leading architectural efforts to unify cross-surface rendering and presentation frameworks across web, mobile, and app experiences.

My work focuses on building durable technical foundations that support rapid experimentation while maintaining reliability, performance, and cost efficiency at scale. I’m particularly interested in large-scale system design, AI-enabled infrastructure, and the practical tradeoffs required to operate complex systems in production.

Beyond engineering, I invest in small, durable businesses with strong operators and recurring revenue models. I’m drawn to long-term value creation and applying systems thinking across both technical and operational domains.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Development Engineer III - Rufus (GenAI Shopping Assistant)
positions.description:
* GenAI Platform Architecture: Led the architecture to consolidate three platform-specific CX rendering stacks — web, mobile web, and native app — into one shared rendering framework built on React Native for Amazon's GenAI shopping assistant (Rufus), eliminating ~50% of duplicated rendering logic and roughly doubling the rate at which new conversational surfaces ship across the organization.

* Backend-for-Frontend Architecture: Designed the BFF layer that reconciles LLM inference output and conversation context with per-request runtime context (customer, marketplace, surface) to produce structured view models for thin clients — choosing centralized response shaping over template-driven client rendering to eliminate cross-surface divergence and keep business logic off the clients.

* Technical Leadership: Technical lead for a multi-region organization of ~40 engineers and 3 engineering managers, owning architecture and operational excellence for Rufus serving layers — holding strict p99 latency through 50K-TPS peaks at major shopping events like Prime Day and Cyber Monday.

* High-Scale Delivery: Architected GenAI-powered conversational workflows delivered to Amazon's 300MM+ monthly active customer base, sustaining reliability through a twice-weekly deployment cadence.

* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partnered with principal engineers, product, and applied-science stakeholders to align model capabilities with the rendering and serving roadmap, shaping the technical direction for next-generation interactive shopping.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer III - Stores
positions.description:
* Federated Platform Architecture: Architected a self-service federated platform — Java services on AWS with a React Native integration layer — that enabled hundreds of internal partner teams to ship personalized content into mobile-first customer experiences independently, removing the central platform team as an integration bottleneck.

* Multi-Org Technical Alignment: Drove technical consensus across three organizations on shared service abstractions and extensible API design, unifying fragmented CX stacks and cutting cross-team integration friction.

* Social Shopping Infrastructure: Built the two-stage ranking and recommendation system behind social shopping — offline candidate generation feeding a near-real-time online reranker at ~300ms p99 — bridging SageMaker-trained models with a low-latency, DynamoDB-backed serving layer.

* Cross-Org Technical Strategy: Led architecture reviews for mission-critical distributed systems across the Stores CX organization and mentored senior engineers across multiple regions.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II - Stores
positions.description:
* Contextual Recommendation Framework: Designed and launched Amazon's first contextual recommendation framework for product entity associations, validated through high-scale A/B experimentation and driving $20MM+ in incremental gross sales.

* High-Throughput Data Pipelines: Built distributed data pipelines on AWS that ingested billions of daily user-behavior signals and catalog-metadata events into DynamoDB-backed stores powering low-latency product discovery.

* Full-Stack Performance: Optimized the interplay between Java frontend service layers and backend data stores, holding latency targets under high concurrency.

* Led backend feature development and infrastructure optimization for high-traffic mobile games.

* Built real-time client-server communication systems over persistent TCP connections, and optimized distributed caching and SQL layers for high concurrency.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead a team of 3 full-stack engineers in coding and development of critical features for a highly-successful game under the company portfolio, Underworld Empire, with responsibility for allocation of project resources, coding quality, and staff training

•	Direct and implement coding best practices to maintain quality and facilitate peer code reviews 
•	Implement standard agile practices, including daily scrums, quick roll outs, bug fixes, and sustainment of high-quality deliverables
•	Institute high-quality coding standards through regular team interaction and mentoring of project milestones 
•	Serve as team lead for cross-functional collaborative design process, and introduced successful game features
•	Mentor and manage team of engineers, facilitate cross-team sync-up and communication, create efficient development process 
•	Lead tech-ops, monitor and optimize backend game infrastructure, drive availability and performance optimization 
•	Automate and optimize server deploy pipeline, enabling quick and stable deploys

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core member who took ownership and leadership for designing and implementing major features which required full stack development for Underworld Empire and Castle Age, two of the most successful games under Kabam portfolio.As one of the versatile members of the team, successfully fulfilled various challenging projects touching almost all the aspects of the technologies involved (front-end IOS and Android clients to back-end PHP, MYSQL, Memcache, Couchbase et al).

•	Was a critical part of full stack developer team that created native Android ports utilizing Java for Castle Age game
•	Performed game optimization via Memcache, SQL, and PHP 
•	Formulated unit test cases and integrated test cases prior to deployment of features/client releases
•	Designed multiple front-end features for IOS clients; employed Objective-C and built frameworks via Cocos2D and Adobe Animate
•	Created robust PHP framework to efficiently manage back end asset pipeline, enabled capability releasing features without client release
•	Developed framework for persistent connection between IOS, Android clients, and related server; applied TCP sockets and Google Protocol to provide real-time updates for high-velocity features in Underworld Empire game

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for development and maintenance of various components of Tigo Energy web application. Developed modules include Tigo Energy’s Reporting System and Ticketing System. Lead developer in a project with Department of Energy, which involved developing algorithms to compute the system performance using solar panel data (Azimuth, Power, Direct Light, Diffused light, etc.), and creating Analytic Dashboard using D3.js to visualize these KPIs. Lead developer in a project involving development and optimization of Tigo Energy System Configuration application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer in the Software-as-a-Service department. Primarily worked on tools and automation for issue resolution / disaster recovery process for the backend service components. Optimized and monitored the back-end infrastructure, and processes of HP SaaS products.

positions.title: Network Support Engineer
positions.description: Assisted in web development and administration of Windows Server 2003 office network, and configured and monitored real time back-up of the main office server. Administered the servers and workstations using remote access services like VNC viewer. Responsible for research, acquisition, and configuration of all new network and server hardware systems.
